_doc: STAGING. Three boards, and three is the whole pack. The cultural bench signed this vocabulary off with additions ONLY on the condition that the theme stop presenting eight-plus nations as one place — either renamed to a single island, or the blurb states plainly that it is a diaspora sampler. It does the latter. Their standing line governs the size: a thin accurate pack is not an insult, a padded one is, and twelve boards here would mean nine boards about nowhere.

theme.name: Which Island
theme.blurb: A sampler, not a country — Jamaica, Trinidad, Barbados, Haiti and more, and the first question anybody asks is which one.

boards.scene: The pan, and what is coming out of it

clues.pecans: Not the nut. The instruments, and the misreading happens constantly
clues.pan: Beaten from an oil drum, tuned by ear, and Trinidad will tell you so
clues.cane: What the fields were, and the reason half these islands share a kitchen
clues.peas: With the rice, and whether they are gungo or red is a whole conversation
clues.aces: What the domino table is not played with, and saying otherwise is a tell
clues.space: What the kitchen runs out of the moment a second pot goes on

boards.scene: Sunday cooking, and the two pots

clues.panels: The steel ones, and the sound carries three streets on a good night
clues.pan: One for the rice, one for the stew, and neither is ever washed properly
clues.peas: Soaking since last night, which is the step people skip and regret
clues.lane: The one behind the shop where the smell reaches the main road
clues.plane: What half the family is on, and the other half is at the airport
clues.pales: What everything else does next to a properly browned stew

clues.parton: Country music, not this — and yet somebody always has it on
clues.pan: The first thing anybody asks about, and the answer names your island
clues.pot: One, big, on the back ring, and it has been in the family longer than you
clues.port: Where the grandparents left from, and the year is stated exactly
clues.apron: On the man cooking, which surprises nobody who has met him
clues.tarp: Over the yard by nine, because the party is happening regardless
